svg.title: The positive trace differs from the symmetric principal value
svg.desc: At lambda one, kappa divided by one plus kappa squared is odd. The model-subtracted imaginary integrand is one over one plus kappa squared with full integral pi. The actual inverse kernel has imaginary limits plus one half from positive r and minus one half from negative r. No value is assigned at zero.
svg.text: Full integral J₊(h) = iπ, including both tails.
Imaginary part of the inverse kernel
Im Kₕ(r) = ½ sgn(r) exp(−|r|), r ≠ 0
Open endpoints mark limits, not point values.
Exact formulas and Fourier constants: TS5–TS11 and Example 1 (TS27). Curves are sampled.
